x, y, n = map(int, input().split())

minA = -1
minB = -1

def updateMin(a, b):
    global minA, minB
    if a < 0:
        return
    if minA == -1:
        minA = a
        minB = b
        return
    diff1 = abs(minB * x - minA * y) * b
    diff2 = abs(b * x - a * y) * minB
    if diff1 > diff2:
        minA = a
        minB = b
    elif diff1 == diff2 and (b < minB or (b == minB and a < minA)):
        minA = a
        minB = b

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    base = i * x // y
    updateMin(base - 1, i)
    updateMin(base, i)
    updateMin(base + 1, i)

print(f"{minA}/{minB}")
</translated_code>
